## Program Operations Manual System (POMS)

TN 12 (02-25)

# GN 00312.072 Burundi – Vital Statistics Records

## A. Introduction to vital statistics records in Burundi

Burundi has no single, nationwide repository of civil registration records. Records are held at the local level in the office of the mayor of the town in which the event occurred or, in the case of birth records, the town where the individual's mother lives.

## B. Procedure for requesting birth, marriage, divorce, and death records

### 1. Office to contact

For birth records, contact the office of the mayor in the town where the individual's mother lives. For marriage, death, and divorce records, contact the office of the mayor in the town where the event took place. Address requests to the Civil Registry Officer (Officier de l'Etat Civil).

Officier de l'Etat Civil

### 2. Birth records

Include the following information in requests for birth records:

  * •

Full name of child at birth;

  * •

Sex of child;

  * •

Date and place of birth, including province of birth;

  * •

Names of the parents, including the maiden surname;

  * •

Names of the parents of a single parent;

  * •

Address at the time of birth;

  * •

Place of residence;

  * •

Parent's or applicant's proof of identity; and

  * •

Applicant's name.
